usage: dns-sd [--verbose] --enumerate
       dns-sd [--verbose] --browse [--timeout=NUMBER] <type> [<domain>]
       dns-sd {--help | --version}

  -v, --verbose  
  -h, --help     Display this help screen then exit
      --version  Print the build version then exit

Operations:

  -E, --enumerate  Enumerate registration domains
  -B, --browse     Browse for services
